evidence_items.finding: over 200 monthly enquiries arriving but fewer than 4 percent proceed to retained client status
evidence_items.rationale: High volume with very low conversion is a critical GTM channel mismatch signal. market_position dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: intake staff spending a substantial proportion of each day on enquiries that do not advance
evidence_items.rationale: Staff time consumed by non-converting enquiries is an adverse operational signal consistent with a channel mismatch. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: average quality of incoming enquiries has declined over the past 12 months as advertising targeting has broadened
evidence_items.rationale: Declining enquiry quality coinciding with broader targeting is a direct GTM channel mismatch signal. market_position dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: a notable proportion of incoming enquiries relate to service categories the firm does not handle
evidence_items.rationale: Out-of-scope enquiries confirming targeting mismatch. market_position dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 1.2M; 6 staff; 200 monthly enquiries; conversion rate below 4 percent; digital advertising the primary acquisition channel with broadened targeting over 18 months
evidence_items.rationale: The combination of high volume, very low conversion, and broadened targeting is the GTM mismatch profile. is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): enquiry volume has grown substantially following 18 months of increased digital advertising investment
evidence_items.rationale: Volume growth from advertising is a misleading signal when the enquiries are not converting. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): intake team follows up each enquiry within 24 hours which the owner considers strong performance
evidence_items.rationale: Fast follow-up is a misleading performance indicator when the enquiries themselves are not in scope for conversion. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): owner believes that more investment in the same advertising channels will produce more retained clients
evidence_items.rationale: Owner attribution of the problem to insufficient advertising volume is a misleading framing signal. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Owner-stated conversion rate is under 4 percent. funnelConversionPct set to 4 as an upper-bound proxy for the adversely low conversion rate.

clarification_requests.would_improve_pattern: fin_isGtmMismatch (conversion rate breakdown by enquiry type would confirm targeting mismatch)
fin_isGtmMismatch (conversion rate by channel would confirm which targeting configuration is generating non-converting volume)

validation_notes: SIM-05-001 is a GTM channel mismatch case where advertising targeting is generating out-of-scope enquiries. No must_identify vocabulary used (targeting mismatch generating out-of-scope enquiries, in-scope versus out-of-scope enquiry conversion gap, intake capacity consumed by unqualifiable leads, advertising configuration as the upstream cause, matter type qualification rate — none appear in findings).
